instruction: Star all emails in the Drafts folder

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 7)) = (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 7);

metadata.explanation: Task requires starring all emails in Drafts folder (folderID=7, contains 7 emails). The evaluator checks if star attribute (attributeID=58, value=1) is set for messages in folder 7. Verified from database: folder 7 is Drafts with 7 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails are starred by comparing count of starred emails to total count of emails in folder 7
Left side: count(*) from messageAttributes WHERE attributeID=58 AND value=1 AND messageID IN (folder 7 messages) - counts starred emails
Right side: count(*) from messages WHERE folderID=7 - counts total emails in Drafts
Equality check ensures ALL emails are starred (starred count == total count), not just ANY
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird to ensure database changes are flushed to disk
Complete coverage: verifies all requirements (correct folder, correct attribute, all emails)
Getter can access the needed state (SQLite database), metric can verify correctly (count equality)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
